title: Social media users are charged with spreading false information
paragraphs: A social media user in Surabaya was charged with spreading false information that caused havoc.
The charge used section 28 verses (3) the ITE Act (false information).
The defendant is not a journalist, he works as an online clothing dealer.
The trial is held at the Surabaya State Court and is postponed until next week.
The defendant's legal authority calls the client's upload a joke.
